`res.Conflicts` is scoped to the current `Import` call only — conflicts recorded in an earlier batch of a multi-batch run are never persisted into `State`/`Progress`. So a later batch that finalizes `Progress.Complete = true` (e.g. a trailing batch that carries only `progress` and no new records, as in the resumable-import pattern) will pass this check even though an earlier page's record has an unresolved equal-timestamp conflict and is still serving stale data. The run gets marked complete, silently presenting conflicted/stale evidence as fully imported.

When `--issue`/`issue` resolves to a record whose `Title` and `Text` are both empty (e.g. an issue observed with only `fields` populated, or with completeness gaps), `issueBriefEvidence` synthesizes `task = "" + "\n" + ""`, i.e. just `"\n"`. `strings.TrimSpace` reduces that to `""`, so the caller's guard fires `task required unless --issue supplies it` even though a valid `--issue` was supplied and resolved — contradicting the documented contract that task text is optional when `--issue` is given.
